response.sql: WITH buckets AS (SELECT o.timespan, COUNT(DISTINCT o.recordvault) AS order_count FROM riskandmargin AS r JOIN orders AS o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), shares AS (SELECT order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM buckets), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(s.order_count) AS total_count, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares AS s CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE s.share > b.average_share
